subject: Moms Demand Action Gun Violence Prevention
overview: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan spoke with Erin Dowd, local lead for Moms Demand Action, regarding grassroots gun violence prevention. Dowd discussed firearm safety statistics, the Be Smart educational program, and efforts to pass a secure storage resolution in Medford schools.

items.title: Guest introduction and local favorite
items.summary: Erin Dowd introduced herself as a clinical social worker and local lead for Moms Demand Action, naming Snappy Patties as her favorite local restaurant.

items.title: Overview and mission of Moms Demand Action
items.summary: Dowd outlined the background of Moms Demand Action under Everytown for Gun Safety, focusing on legislative advocacy, gun sense candidate elections, and partnerships with violence prevention programs.

items.title: Gun violence data and trends
items.summary: Dowd reviewed statistics showing firearms as the leading cause of death among children and teens, increases in Massachusetts gun sales, and high rates of firearm suicides.

items.title: Be Smart program and secure gun storage
items.summary: Dowd explained the adult-focused Be Smart framework, which encourages normalizing conversations about firearm safety and complying with secure storage laws.

items.title: Medford outreach and school committee resolution
items.summary: Dowd described community outreach in Medford and highlighted a school committee motion put forward by member Melanie McLaughlin to regularly notify families about secure firearm storage.

items.title: Community involvement and election resources
items.summary: Dowd shared ways for residents to join the Medford group, announced an upcoming October 16 meeting, and highlighted the Gun Sense Voter resource for the election season.
